formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Sets the owner's miMATIC allowance for the spender to exactly `value`, replacing any earlier allowance (permit: allowance[target][spender] = value).
An allowance of type(uint256).max is never reduced by transferFrom, so it is a true unlimited approval.
Uses up the owner's current nonce (nonces[target]++), so earlier signed permits with that nonce stop working.
The signature can be submitted by anyone until `deadline` (require(block.timestamp <= deadline)). No tokens move when it is signed.
formats.shown: "Authorize spending of tokens" with the spender address, the max spending amount in miMATIC ("Unlimited" at or above 2^255), the deadline as a date, and the owner. The nonce is hidden.

findings.title: Permit has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line names no spender, amount or token.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats Permit: "intent": "Authorize spending of tokens", no interpolatedIntent; the fields spender and value are always visible and could go into the sentence.
findings.fix: Add "interpolatedIntent": "Allow {spender} to spend up to {value} until {deadline}".
